This 1.6L engine from Polor has been refurbished and is more durable than it's used counterpart. Factoring in price and quality, this is the most all-round option out of the three 1.6L engines. All engines provide the same level of performance.

Asiatic Dynamics' used 1.6L engine will be much less durable than the refurbished-high or new-very high variants, as it is only of medium quality. However, this does mean it's the cheapest. All engines provide the same level of performance.

The brand new 1.6L engine from Echo is the most durable 1.6L engine on the market, this makes it the strongest and longest lasting engine of the three variants, but this does come at a greater cost. All engines provide the same level of performance.
This Loop clutch is brand new and is an expensive option, but is much more durable than the Asiatic Dynamics and Duotone parts.
Asiatic Dynamics offer a twin plate clutch that is the least durable clutch available, however it is the cheapest too.
The Duotone clutch has recently been refurbished and is more durable than the clutch from Asiatic Dynamics. It does cost more though, and provides a good balance of quality and price.
Shark now offer the best Rally2 clutch on the market, this part is the most durable clutch available, but it is also the most expensive.
This Duotone clutch is brand new and is more expensive, but is much more durable than the Polor and Jingshen parts.
Polor offer a two disc clutch that is the least durable clutch available, however it is the cheapest too.
The Jingshen clutch has recently been refurbished and is more durable than the Polor clutch. It does cost more though, but provides a good balance of quality and price.
Shark now offer the best Rally3 clutch on the market, this part is the most durable clutch available, but does also make it the most expensive.

This 2L engine from Equinox has been refurbished and is more durable than it's used Polor counterpart. Factoring in price and quality, this is the most all-round option out of the three 2L engines. All engines provide the same level of performance.

Polor's used 2L engine will be much less durable than the refurbished-high or new-very high variants, as it is only of medium quality. However, this does mean it's the cheapest. All engines provide the same level of performance.

The brand new 2L engine from RGB is the most durable 2L engine on the market, this makes it the strongest and longest lasting engine of the three variants, but this does come at a greater cost. All engines provide the same level of performance.

The new XER 5-speed sequential gearbox is more durable than the refurbished Euterpe gearbox, however it is also more expensive. XER also offer the same tuning capabilities for their gearbox as Euterpe do, with just allowing you to adjust the final drive.

The used 5-speed sequential gearbox from 7even is the least durable Rally1 gearbox on the market. It offers no custom tuning abilities either. However, it is the cheapest gearbox, good if you are on a strict budget.
Euterpe's refurbished 5-speed gearbox provides a nice balance of cost and durability. This part will also allow you to tune the final drive of the gearbox too.
